$comment: Entry schema for contributes.schedules (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_schedules.go and schedules_runner.go. While the plugin is enabled and effective in the active workspace, the host calls action (one of the plugin's contributes.actions with risk read and maxPayloadBytes of at least {{limits.payloadMinBytes}}) every intervalMinutes ({{limits.intervalMinMinutes}}-{{limits.intervalMaxMinutes}}) with the payload {"schedule": id, "firedAt": RFC 3339 time}, activating the plugin on demand (timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.concurrentPerPlugin}} call per plugin at a time, result at most {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes and otherwise ignored). The first run happens one interval after the host starts or the plugin becomes effective; failures double the delay up to {{limits.backoffMaxMinutes}} minutes. A schedule only wakes the plugin: to tell the user something it calls host.notify or host.statusBar.update itself. Nothing runs while MinCode is closed.
description: Schedules: periodic background calls of one of the plugin's read actions, for example checking for expiring certificates or failed pipelines.

action.description: One of this plugin's contributes.actions ids with risk read.
